My Best Meal in Saigon in Almost Six Months Here
Jan 2020
Way better than I expected it to be. Had the "Fried Pho With Beef" (75,000 VND) and the "Pork Deep Fried Spring Rolls" (49,000 VND). Portions were ample and flavors were bold and totally spot on. Noodles, freshly made, were actually deep fried until gnarled and delicious, then topped with the tastiest beef-veggie stir-fry imaginable. Spring rolls were stuffed with sausage. I made a slurry of fish sauce and garlic-chili mush for dipping. The way to go. Ingredients used were top-notch - they went a long way towards making the meal excellent. Really can't recommend this place highly enough. You do pay more here but you get way better food and more of it, and air-conditioned confines, too. Can't go wrong. I only cry in my beer that I didn't try this place months ago as I've been walking past it for the longest time. This joint will enable you to understand why VN food is much-loved and sought-after.

Creative n colorful pho with reasonable price
Jun 2019 • Family
We just had dinner here and ordered their colorful fresh spring roll as appetizer with beef, chicken and sausage which is very pretty to the eyes but just okay in taste. They offer lots of options and you could choose the meat you'd like for your pho, they also have seafood pho on their menu and serve them with loads of veggies, the broth is pretty good so I would recommend it. Uniquely, they have stir fried pho which is interesting as it has a crispy chewy texture and comes in multiple colors as well. Worth a try if you are feeling a bit bored with the common pho. Decent price, with air con, place is clean and well kept, english menu and the server is very friendly and tried hard to explain their dishes even with her limited english.

vegan and meat eaters can both enjoy!
May 2019 • Friends
This restaurant has a colorful menu with a variety of unique dishes, invented (I presume) by the chef/owners. For example, pho rolls, pho without broth, vegan and vegetarian variations of the same dishes, and colored noodles (colored by fruits and vegetables, made in house). My meaty meal was delicious, one of the best I've had in Vietnam! My vegan friends equally loved their meals. The server spoke decent English and really took pride in the quality of food being served, as well as the nutritional aspects. The prices were above average but nothing outrageous.
